  function loftGeometry(stations, undercut = 0) {
    const p = [], uv = [], triangles = [];
    const radial = 28, perSection = 4;
    const sections = (stations.length-1)*perSection;
    for (let row = 0; row <= sections; row++) {
      const i = Math.min(stations.length-2,Math.floor(row/perSection));
      const f = row/perSection - i;
      const a = stations[Math.max(0,i-1)], b = stations[i];
      const c = stations[i+1], d = stations[Math.min(i+2,stations.length-1)];
      const x = mix(b[0],c[0],f);
      const span = c[0]-b[0];
      function component(j) {
        const y0 = b[j] || 0, y1 = c[j] || 0;
        const m0 = ((c[j] || 0) - (a[j] || 0)) / (c[0]-a[0]) * span;
        const m1 = ((d[j] || 0) - (b[j] || 0)) / (d[0]-b[0]) * span;
        return y0 + f*(m0 + f*(3*(y1-y0)-2*m0-m1 + f*(m0+m1-2*(y1-y0))));
      }
      const y = component(1), ry = Math.max(.008,component(2));
      const rz = Math.max(.008,component(3)), z = component(4);
      for (let j = 0; j <= radial; j++) {
        const angle = (j/radial - 0.5)*TAU;
        const aY = Math.cos(angle), aZ = Math.sin(angle);
        const carved = 1 + undercut*Math.min(aY,0);
        p.push(x,y+ry*aY,z+rz*aZ*carved);
        uv.push((x-stations[0][0])/(stations[stations.length-1][0]-stations[0][0]), j/radial);
        if (row < sections && j < radial) {
          const a = row*(radial+1)+j, b = a+radial+1;
          triangles.push(a,a+1,b,a+1,b+1,b);
        }
      }
    }
    const geom = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    geom.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(p,3));
    geom.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));
    geom.setIndex(triangles);
    geom.computeVertexNormals();
    return geom;
  }
